newsitem.title: USA: Quest for Value links shr price drop to tax credit.
newsitem.headline: Quest for Value links shr price drop to tax credit.

text.p: Quest for Value Dual Purpose Fund on Friday said its share price dropped because purchasers were no longer entitled to a tax credit for the year.
By early afternoon on the New York Stock Exchange, Quest for Value capital shares were trading at 35-7/8, down 2-3/4 from the closing price on Thursday.
The fund previously said that it would pay income tax of about $3.15 per capital share, and that shareholders will be entitled to a tax credit or refund in the same amount.
Quest said that purchases of capital shares on Friday would settle on the first businesss day of 1997 and were no longer entitled to the credit.
